description: Use when the user answers a question about the team they are building. Saves to their team draft, the one the Build-my-team page edits: answers is merged into the saved answers (e.g. {"goal":"grow_store"} or {"brief":{"company":{"name":"Acme"}}}; null removes a key), templateSlug picks the team, step moves the page's step. Creates the draft when there is none. Never put passwords, tokens or keys in it. Returns the draft and the page link. Launches and charges nothing. No cost to call.

answers.description: Merged into the saved answers (JSON merge patch); null removes a key.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: The draft's updatedAt as last read, to refuse a stale write.

name: update_team_draft

outputSchema.description: The draft as the Build-my-team page shows it, with its link.

title: Update Team Draft
